title: Migration Hub
introduction: Your centralized platform for managing migrations across IBM Cloud products and services. It identifies the resources in your account that require action, helps you plan your migration process, and guides you through each step — with instructions, documentation, and tools for transitions.

section_highlights.title: Migrating from Classic Infrastructure to VPC
section_highlights.description: Learn how to transition your workloads from IBM Cloud Classic Infrastructure to Virtual Private Cloud for enhanced security and performance.

section_highlights.title: Overview of Gen 1 (Classic) and Gen 2 (VPC)
section_highlights.description: Complete your Gen 2 migration in phases with these building blocks. Requirements and tools vary by database type and deployment.

tiles.title: Migration Hub is now available in the IBM Cloud console. The centralized platform for managing migrations across IBM Cloud products and services.
